responsive.description: 湖南美创数字科技有限公司，专注文化与科技融合。连接文化研究、空间设计、数字技术与 AI，让文化成为可感知、可参与的体验。
MGC Digital connects cultural research, creative design and digital technology to shape exhibitions, museums, cultural products and operations.
以空间叙事连接文物、历史与观众，让遗址文化进入今天的体验。
把秦简中的文字与日常，转化为可读、可感、可参与的历史体验。
在历史建筑中组织文化叙事，让保护、展示与体验形成连贯的空间。
Connecting the roots of an archaeological culture with a contemporary museum experience.

MGC helped renew the Liye museum through exhibition design and implementation, combining layered interpretation, a bowl-screen theatre and over 30 multimedia interactives to bring Qin-era records to life.
Potala Palace Snow City Exhibition Renewal, a 2021 project in the museums portfolio. MGC scope: design and construction.
数字展示、数字文博、数字文创与数字运营，连接文化研究、空间设计和数字技术。
Cultural research, exhibition design, digital production and museum software.
从里耶秦简出发，体验识别、解读、表达与空间化的文化转化过程。预置概念演示，无实时 AI 接口。
Explore the Liye manuscripts through recognition, interpretation, expression and space. A curated concept without a live AI connection.
文物数字化、智慧博物馆与互动系统。查看美创公开研究、项目及证据。
Digital heritage, museum systems and interactive research.
与美创数字讨论文化展示、智慧文博、文创开发与合作需求。商务咨询：0731-89728572。
